assets.scope: Caller-supplied already-recorded external Backdrop, opaque transparent-source fallback and finite positive local physical-pixel rectangle. Five one-pixel regions at center and20/30,80/30,20/70,80/70 percent form a5x1 sample. Captured sRGB channels are weighted directly by.2126/.7152/.0722; this is not linear-light luminance or native sampling support. Consumers must exclude themselves and adaptive backing from the source.
assets.sampleOrdering: UI-thread recording/toImageBitmap precedes CPU readback from the returned standalone bitmap on a worker; hardware bitmaps are copied to ARGB_8888 there. No source layer, DrawScope or LayoutCoordinates is passed to the worker. At most one request is in flight. Frozen samples remain ordered historical observations tagged with snapshot/completion times and direct LayerBackdrop recording revision when available, followed by newer content. Wrapped Backdrops, including withContentSignal, have null sourceRevision; the signal is not a completed recording revision. Content versions may be skipped and a callback is not promised to describe the current frame. Source identity, geometry or configuration changes invalidate incompatible results. Other sources must expose observed snapshot invalidation or complete caller notifications; a parent recording version does not automatically cover retained child updates.
assets.consumerIsolation: The modifier retains its own consumer graphicsLayer so observer invalidation does not rerecord a sibling source in a shared layer and feed recording revisions back into sampling. Unchanged draws do not poll. This implementation contract is not a new device or performance acceptance claim.
assets.supportLimits: API<28, unavailable coordinates or invalid geometry produce no sample. Relative scale/rotation requires caller transform compensation. The5x1 target does not bound traversal, GPU work or UI latency; independent support and performance are unaccepted.

assets.scope: An explicit observable resampling request for an external source whose retained leaves can redraw without parent recording. Notify on the UI thread after the corresponding source update is available to draw. assets.wrapperOwnership: Retain one signal for source leaves of one scene and retain source.withContentSignal(signal), for example with remember(source, signal). Each call creates a new wrapper; replacing it changes sampler source identity. The wrapper observes the signal while delegating source drawing and coordinate-dependence unchanged. Wrapped samples have null sourceRevision.
assets.callerOwnership: Cover every independently retained pane-free source leaf. Place notifyBackdropDraw inside that leaf's own graphicsLayer/clip boundary before drawing modifiers; it notifies after drawContent returns. A parent containing other retained children does not observe their later redraws. The modifier creates no retained isolation. Layer-property-only and native drawing updates require explicit owner notification after the update is available to draw; notifying early at a pending state mutation can sample old pixels without a later notification. Never notify from optical consumers or include them in the source.
